narrative: Material PL2__MA3BEFE0 exhibits lumpy, high-variability demand (CV=0.77) with 13% zero-demand days and an empirical distribution unsuitable for parametric assumptions. Lead times are unstable (CV=0.41, mean=2.78 days), requiring robust safety stock of 1,201 units at the 95% service level. The EOQ of 2,607 units is storage-constrained to 2,027 units (SS+OQ=3,228=capacity), yielding a 48% total cost reduction versus the current SAP policy of ordering at MOQ=468 with zero safety stock.
warnings: Storage capacity constraint is binding: EOQ 2608 reduced to 2027 units (max_storage_units=3228.23, safety_stock=1201).

research_insights.selection_rationale: With lumpy but sufficiently frequent demand (87% non-zero days) and unstable lead times, a continuous-review (r,Q) policy provides real-time stockout protection via the reorder point while the fixed EOQ-derived order quantity minimises total replenishment and holding costs. Periodic review would add unnecessary exposure given the demand volatility.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap reduces order quantity from EOQ 2608 to 2027, increasing expected order frequency slightly above the economic optimum. If demand surges above mean, the reduced batch size may increase stockout risk marginally; monitor fill rate and consider a storage expansion request if service level falls below 93%.
